Players Committee card image of [[Knights Of The Old Republic]] (original printing), game text: “USED: If present with a Dark Jedi or [Episode I] Jedi, your Padawan is power +2 for remainder of turn. OR Deploy one [Episode I] lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: Once per game, retrieve a Padawan or [Episode I] lightsaber.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/knightsoftheoldrepublic.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
